preparation.validity: Clean holdout only for future scratch models trained with this derived exclusion index. Historical checkpoints may have trained on these questions; do not claim they are unseen by those models.
preparation.reference_limit: Supplied programs can disagree or be unsupported by the numeric runner. Report usable-reference denominators; do not rewrite or select references based on results.

reference_audit.note: Restricted numeric runner diagnostics only; unsupported references are not automatically incorrect. No rows are removed based on these results.

tokenizer_overlap_scope: Zero exact question-column overlap with shard zero; strings inside original code/comments were not audited.
usage: Use for new scratch-model comparisons with the paired derived exclusion index. Do not use to claim unseen accuracy for historical checkpoints.
